heading: Run a text task
intro: Choose the model that will receive your task. The result is saved on this computer.
model_hint: Use the provider's model ID, for example qwen3.5:2b for Ollama.
consent: I authorize this task to send its instructions to the selected cloud provider and understand it may incur charges.
empty: Your saved tasks will appear here.
busy: A task is running. Open it below to check its status.
invalid_form: Enter instructions up to 12 KiB and a token limit from 32 to 2048.
invalid_model: Enter a model ID valid for the selected provider.
need_consent: Explicitly approve cloud inference for this task.
need_key: Set the selected provider’s key in the workbench environment, then restart.
provider_unavailable: The provider did not accept the request or could not be reached. Check its configuration before starting a new task.
invalid_reply: The provider did not return a complete text response.
local_policy: Ollama could not verify local execution for this model. Check the model and server version.
timeout: The request exceeded the two-minute limit.
title: Agentic Company OS
interrupted_help: The previous process stopped before it saved a result. The task was not sent again.
output_limit_reached: The response reached an output limit. Start a new task with an appropriate token limit.
